name: deks-plugin
description: Operate DEKS safely and design coherent, animated presentations with an opinionated visual method.

interface.shortDescription: Build animated decks with the DEKS MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connect an agent to a DEKS workspace, inspect reusable assets, create and edit checkpoint content, choose cohesive palettes, choreograph semantic transitions, validate live renders, and export portable .deks presentations. Separate skills cover the product contract and an opinionated presentation-design method.
defaultPrompt: Create a coherent presentation in DEKS using the design methodology.
Improve the layout and motion of my DEKS deck.
Audit my presentation's story, palette, layout, and transitions.
